Mali.title: Kidal: six wounded evacuated to Gao, the Fla speaks of released soldiers
Mali.summary: AT this TIME The International Committee of the Red Cross specifies that it organized this evacuation after obtaining security guarantees from all parties to the conflict. Its press release does not give the identity of the persons transferred and does not specify their status. This discretion corresponds to his mandate as a neutral intermediary and the confidential nature of his dialogue with the belligerents On the same day, the Azawad Liberation Front announced that it had entrusted six wounded Malian soldiers, captured in previous clashes, to the ICRC.

Mali.title: Targeted financial sanctions: Bamako expands its security pressure tool
Mali.summary: AT THIS TIME The text provides for the freezing of the property and economic resources of the persons concerned for six renewable months. It is based on national texts relating to the fight against money laundering, the financing of terrorism and the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction . The grievances are formulated identically for the twelve names: alleged support for JNIM and the Azawad Liberation Front, promotion or apology of terrorism, criminal association and facilitation of terrorist acts.

Mali.title: BAMEX 2025: A strategic strengthening of military cooperation in Mali
Mali.summary: This exhibition, which takes place in two phases, began with an exhibition at the Bamako Exhibition Park and continues with practical demonstrations at the Boubacar Sada Sy Center in Koulikoro. It offers a unique opportunity to discover state-of-the-art equipment, presented by more than 30 international companies, mainly Turkish, but also Russian and Chinese .

Mali.title: FAMa: positions of armed groups targeted in Abéïbara and near Sévaré
Mali.summary: AT THIS MOMENT The Malian army continues its air operations against the armed groups active in the country. In a statement issued Wednesday, August 26, the General Staff of the Armed Forces reported a series of strikes in the north and center of Mali, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to the military hierarchy, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible, on Monday, August 24, to locate several regroupment points of armed terrorist groups in Abéïbara, in the Kidal region.

Mali.title: 65th anniversary of the Malian Army: the nation pays tribute to its forces
Mali.summary: Mali commemorated this Tuesday the 65th anniversary of the creation of its national army, on the occasion of an official ceremony presided over by the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces .

Mali.title: Senou: A dangerous network of inoperable motorcycle robbers
Mali.summary: FIGHT AGAINST DELINQUENCY and CRIME: As part of the strengthening of security, the Senou Police Station, headed by Chief Police Commissioner Cheickna SOW, arrested three (03) individuals suspected of being members of a criminal network on 19 September 2026 The operation, carried out by the Research Brigade, follows the denunciation of several cases of motorcycle theft in the peripheral districts of Bamako and the surrounding localities, sometimes followed by robberies.

Mali.title: Crash of the Air Algérie flight AH5017 in Mali, the judgment expected in Paris
Mali.summary: Twelve years after the crash of Air Algérie flight AH5017, judgment is expected on Monday, September 28, 2026 in Paris. The aircraft, operated by the Spanish company Swiftair and chartered by Air Algérie, crashed on 24 July 2014 near Gossi, in the Timbuktu region. All 116 people on board, including a Malian, had perished.

Burkina Faso.title: 6 Burkina Faso: Night of the People's Progressive Revolution - The main achievements presented to the population
Burkina Faso.summary: The Night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was an opportunity to present the main achievements made during the four years of Captain Ibrahim Traoré. From the reconquest of the territory to diplomacy, via agriculture, health and culture, everything demonstrates that Burkina Faso is resolutely committed to its sovereignty and development . In addition to the tribute to the Defence and Security Forces (FDS) and the Volunteers for the Defence of the Fatherland (VDP), the first edition of the night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was a real moment of accountability.

Niger.title: Niger: the mutiny that targeted the heart of power
Niger.summary: RIGHT NOW The events of August 29th go far beyond a barracks protest. They establish an armed mutiny directed against several strategic sites, but the public elements do not yet allow to reconstitute an organized project of seizure of power Three days after the shots that shook Niamey, the Nigerien authorities are once again in control of Air Base 101, Diori-Hamani International Airport, the presidential palace and the other targeted sites.

Niger.title: Agadez: the Regional Security Council examines the security situation and recommends strengthening the existing system
Niger.summary: The Governor of the Region of Agadez, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa, chaired, on Wednesday, March 11, 2026, the regular meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS), held in the usual meeting room in the Governorate of Agadez . This meeting allowed the members of this forum to examine the security situation in the region and identify the measures necessary to strengthen the protection of populations and their property.

Niger.title: Agadez: Ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS)
Niger.summary: Agadez, Sept. 24 (ANP) – The Governor of the Region of Agadez, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa chaired, on Thursday, September 24, 2026, an ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS). Several items were on the agenda of this meeting, including the assessment of the security situation in the region .
